item.description: On July 29, 2025, at 23:24 Universal Time, a long stretch of seafloor off Russia's Kamchatka Peninsula was thrust upward. item.description: False videos are circulating after the attempted hijacking of a Flydubai flight between Dubai and Tel Aviv.
